observed_behavior.statement: Field bat buoc cua quick-add chi bao bang vien do (border-danger), khong co text message nao giai thich.
Modal Display settings: 5 radio deu disabled, khong radio nao checked du record co gia tri san (color_display_type='radio'); chi 'Edit label' dung duoc; Save khong gui 2 field display_type.
Cot 'Custom Printareas' luon hien 'No printareas' sau khi bat toggle du product base da co printarea 'Front'; click/double-click/Enter khong mo editor nao - chua tim duoc duong UI gan.
Tooltip cua toggle goi ten cot 'Connect custom printarea', lech voi header that 'Custom Printareas'.
Template download va Export dung chung 1 bo cot, thieu TIB Variant ID va printarea -> export roi import lai se mat lien ket ID/printarea.
Xu ly rong khong nhat quan trong cung payload insert_variants: Weight rong gui chuoi rong "", Compare price rong bi loai khoi payload han -> luu khac nhau (weight='' vs compare_at_price=null).

observed_validations.input: SKU trung y het mot variant da co trong cung product base
moi field (SKU/Color/Size/Price) de trong, bam Add
observed_validations.message_verbatim: (khong co text message, chi vien do border-danger)

permissions.statement: Chi quan sat duoc 1 role (owner); chua biet role khac co bi gioi han them/sua variant hay khong.

portal.item: /products/{id}/edit, section Variants (table, quick-add, Display settings modal, toggle custom printarea, Download/Export)

api.item: Hasura GraphQL insert_variants / getVariant (pre-check SKU) / update_products (toggle + display settings)

dependencies.relation: cot Custom Printareas du dinh tro toi printarea cua feature nay (chua tim duoc duong UI gan)

risks.risk: POST /api/staff-activity-logs/variant tra 404 o moi lan them variant (2/2) trong khi endpoint tuong tu cho printarea tra 201; variant van tao thanh cong nhung modal Logs khong co entry nao cho variant -> audit trail thieu cho toan bo hoat dong variant.
Xu ly gia tri rong khong nhat quan trong cung payload (Weight='' vs Compare price=null) co the gay sai lech du lieu/kho du doan khi query hoac hien thi lai.
Modal Display settings hien toan bo radio disabled/khong checked du record co gia tri - co the la bug UI khien user tuong chua cau hinh gi.
Export/Template thieu cot ID va printarea - vong export-sua-import se khong giu duoc lien ket, rui ro tao trung/lech du lieu khi thao tac hang loat.

INFERRED (KB-041): pham vi unique SKU (product_id, fulfillment_linked_id) chi suy tu pre-check client + hanh vi clone giu nguyen SKU, CHUA xac nhan constraint DB that - KHONG duoc coi la business rule da xac nhan khi viet test case.
